task.title: Phase N N6.9: importing over an existing flow requires WORKFLOW_EDIT, decided race-safely inside the flow store's critical section (VA-11)
task.objective: Implement awkit-vra.15.9: keep WORKFLOW_CREATE at the flows:import entry; the flow store (importOverwrite authorize) checks existence by stat inside the folder lane and cross-process lock and, for an existing target (including an unparseable one, never read or quarantined first), requires an authorizer that re-evaluates WORKFLOW_EDIT at the moment of decision with a deadline (timeout is a denial), before any quarantine, visual-baseline invalidation or write; a refusal is the typed audited ProfileImportOverwriteError (FLOW_IMPORT_OVERWRITE_FORBIDDEN) and leaves the flow, epoch token, index and records unchanged; other stores keep their import semantics. Add verify:flow-import-authorization covering I1-I9 and six mutations.

acceptance.description: Cases I1-I9 pass on a real flow store configured like production with real approvals, each of the six mutations is observed red, the handler and factory wiring are pinned, other stores keep their import, and the IPC contract, profile-store and lifecycle regressions stay green.
awkit-vra.15.9 closed, the verifier classified, dashboard pins updated and Sources agree, pushed to main.
